notes: All forward rates are maturity-weighted approximations from the same cached spot families, including KRW.
5bp gross move to the 0.25-sigma exit target per complete package; evaluated on the historical signal date before next-close execution.
No execution costs, qualification tiers or historical-profit gates. Evidence is descriptive, not a recommendation or actual holding.
PCA is used only for spot shapes; forward and cross-market structures use mean-fade and conditioned fits.
BDP file modification time identifies cache acquisition, not exchange quote time. Current indications require same-day, recent, coherent snapshots and are not executable quotes.
The expanded universe and parameters are exploratory; previously inspected periods are not an untouched holdout.
